title: Cauliflower Potato and Pea Curry
description: A dry-style vegetable curry of potatoes and cauliflower simmered in spiced tomatoes with peas, coriander and lemon juice.
ingredients: about 500g (1lb 2oz) potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks
1 medium cauliflower, cut into same-sized florets
large handful of coriander leaves, chopped, plus extra to serve
SPICE MIX: 1 tsp mustard seeds, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp nigella seeds, 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes
steps: Make up the spice mix by mixing all the ingredients together in a small bowl.
Spray a sauté pan (with a lid) with oil and stir-fry the potatoes and cauliflower for 5 minutes. Add the spice mix and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the tomatoes, coriander, measured boiling water and salt, place the lid on the pan and leave to simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the peas, squeeze in the lemon juice and cook over a high heat for 3 minutes, giving the sauce a good bubble and allowing it to reduce and thicken. Garnish with some more coriander and serve.
notes: Great stand-alone dish or serve with a mix of other dishes for a family curry night. Serve with cucumber and mint raita: combine 250g fat-free Greek yogurt, 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped mint, finely chopped cucumber, a couple of pinches of salt and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala.
